_doc: TEMPLATE HERO CLASS. Classes power Character Creation: the player picks a name, class, and aura color. Each class resolves starter spells from spells/spells.json and level-up growth from 'growth'. voiceKeywords let players pick the class by speech.
title: Elementalist
subtitle: Master of Primordial Elements
description: Wields blistering fire, piercing frost, and crackling storm incantations. High magical burst damage.
